correctness.rationale: The free C3 action gives free integral group-ring cellular chains; Babson–Kozlov determines the unique top reduced homology and rank. Schanuel plus the C3 period-two free resolution forces the stable syzygy. The three-type integral C3-lattice classification, reduced mod3 to distinguish block sizes, forces the actual direct sum. The homology Serre spectral sequence, free top chain kernel, Euler count, cohomology spectral sequence and UCT give the full quotient groups and algebra. Standalone mod3 orbit and chain-action computations pass n≤7; no finite result is extrapolated without the structural proof.
